bait_content.title: Profile Recovery: Unclean Shutdown Detected
bait_content.body: The previous session ended unexpectedly. The browser profile lockfile indicates an unclean exit and the cache index (IndexedDB/LocalStorage, service worker data) may be out of sync. Running recovery will replay journal entries and revalidate tab and extension state. You can skip this step, but some data may fail to load correctly.
